description: This file contains multiple class definitions for extensions related to Orleans grains, including specific and generic extension classes, with methods for checking extension properties and messaging capabilities.

classes.name: TestExtension
classes.description: An internal class implementing ITestExtension, providing methods to check extension properties and messaging.

classes.name: SimpleExtension
classes.description: A class implementing ISimpleExtension, encapsulating a string and providing a method to retrieve it.

classes.name: AutoExtension
classes.description: A class implementing IAutoExtension, providing a simple method returning a fixed string.

classes.name: GenericTestExtension<T>
classes.description: A generic class implementing IGenericTestExtension<T>, providing methods to check extension properties and messaging with grains.

methods.name: CheckExtension_1
methods.description: Returns the extension property or value associated with the grain or string.

methods.name: CheckExtension_2
methods.description: Sends a message to a grain to get its label, demonstrating messaging capability within extensions.
